---
title: "About This Blog"
---

This blog is maintained by summer research assistants in the [UBC Department of Mathematics](https://www.math.ubc.ca/). Each RA contributes posts describing their research project, methods, and findings over the course of the summer.

## Supervisor

**[Khanh Dao Duc](https://kdaoduc.com/)** — Assistant Professor, UBC Mathematics & Computer Science
Research combines mathematical, computational, and statistical tools to study biological processes and complex datasets.
[khanh.daoduc@ubc.ca](mailto:khanh.daoduc@ubc.ca)

## Maintainer

**Riddhi Battu** — Research and Data Manager, UBC Mathematics [riddhi.battu@ubc.ca](mailto:riddhi.battu@ubc.ca)

## How Posts Are Added

RAs work on individual Git branches and open pull requests to add new posts. See the [How to Contribute](posts/how-to-contribute/index.qmd) post for step-by-step instructions.

## Blog Infrastructure

This blog is built with [Quarto](https://quarto.org) and deployed to [GitHub Pages](https://pages.github.com/) via GitHub Actions.
